components.css: .ds-faq{background:var(--paper,#f6f7f2);color:var(--ink,#17200f);border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-line,#d8dece);font:15px/1.75 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif}.ds-faq summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;min-height:74px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-faq svg{width:22px;height:22px;flex:0 0 22px}.ds-faq[open] svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-faq[open] summary{color:#446224}.ds-faq summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#17200f);outline-offset:4px}.ds-faq p{padding:0 40px 23px 0;color:var(--paper-muted,#505a46)}
